title: CaPa: Efficient 4K Textured Mesh Generation
heroTitle: CaPa: Carve-n-Paint Synthesis for Efficient 4K Textured Mesh Generation
overview: CaPa is a fully feed-forward Carve-n-Paint system that separates mesh-compatible geometry generation from high-resolution texture synthesis.

Its model-agnostic Spatially Decoupled Attention prevents duplicated features across views without retraining the underlying 2D model, enabling the first image-to-3D pipeline to deliver complete 4K textured meshes in under 30 seconds. The result became a turning point toward the in-house VARCO 3D service.
contributions: Led the geometry and texture pipeline, delivering 4K textured meshes in under 30 seconds.
Trained an occupancy-based 3D latent diffusion model for mesh-compatible geometry.
Designed training-free Spatially Decoupled Attention to resolve cross-view Janus artifacts.
Built 3D-aware occlusion inpainting that restores hidden surfaces in about five seconds.
